Court No. - 14

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9245 of 2023
Applicant :- Ajay Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Sandeep Kumar Srivastava Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
Learned AGA informs that he has procured complete instructions in the matter including up to date case diary.
Charge sheet in the matter has already been submitted.
Heard Shri Sandeep Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the accused/applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Ajay Kumar for grant of bail, in Case Crime No. 14 of 2023, under Sections 376 & 506 IPC, Police Station Gurbuxganj, District Raebareli during trial.

Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that it is a case of false implication and the applicant has not committed any offence as claimed by the informant/ victim.
Ajay Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

It is further submitted that this case is nothing but the counter blast of an FIR which was lodged on 30.4.2022 at Police Station Gurbuxganj, District Raebareli by the wife of the applicant against the husband of the informant/ victim of the instant case pertaining to commission of rape by the husband of the informant/ victim of this case on the wife of the applicant and after investigation the charge sheet was also filed therein and in that case the husband of the informant/ prosecutrix of the instant case had to remain in prison and to settle the scores this false case has been lodged.

It is further submitted that since the lodging of the FIR against the husband of the informant/ victim of the instant case continuous attempts are being made to falsely implicate the instant applicant.

Elaborating further the attention of this Court was drawn to Annexures No.2,3,4 and 5 of the bail application which are the two applications moved by one Smt. Jyoti as well as by the applicant pertaining to the commission of rape by the instant applicant and his associates.
However, all these applications have been dismissed for non prosecution and as not pressed.

It is also submitted that the age of the victim of the instant case is about 30 years and she had also refused to go under any internal medical examination and the story which has been cooked up by the prosecutrix/ victim is so weak and improbable which could not be believed by any normal prudent person as it is highly improbable to commit rape on the victim while three ladies of the house are sleeping nearby, which according to the informant at once came to the spot after hearing her alarm.

The applicant is in jail in this case since 28.3.2023 and there is no apprehension that the accused-applicant after release on bail, may flee from the process of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.
The applicant is also not having any criminal history.
Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer for bail but could not dispute the other factual submissions made by the learned counsel for the accused-applicant.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is transpired from the record that the prior to the instant case the wife of the applicant had lodged a First Information Report against the husband of the informant/ victim of the instant case Anil @ Tulla Lodh on 3.4.2023.

It is also stated that the husband of the informant had to remain in jail for a long time and on account of this, this false case has been lodged by filing application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C.
with the help of the legal professional.

Attention of this Court was also drawn on the two applications moved under Sections 156(3) Cr.P.C. by one Jyoti and the other by informant/ victim of the instant case and in both these application the allegation of commission of rape has been levelled against the applicant and his associates and both these applications are shown to have been dismissed for want of prosecution/ not pressed.
The prosecutrix is aged about 30 years.
She has refused to undergo internal medical examination.
The applicant is not having any criminal antecedent.
He is in jail in this case since 28.3.2023.
His presence may be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

Keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits and demerits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.
Ajay Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Let the applicant- Ajay Kumar involved in the aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
Observations made herein-above are only for the purpose of disposal of bail application and the same shall not have any bearing on the trial of the case.
Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Muk  Ajay Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
